args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 began failing health checks in production across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) immediately after deployment, with an error rate of ~18%. Per the runbook, rolled back all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed and verified: all regions now running v2.3.0. Incident opened to track follow-up investigation of the v2.3.1 failure.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary:

**Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks in all three production regions with an 18% error rate. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — rollout completed and verified.
2. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** titled "checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0", documenting the failure and the rollback. The on-call engineer has been paged.
3. **Verified recovery:** the service is now healthy in all regions on v2.3.0, with error rate down to 0.2%.

**Follow-up recommendation:** the v2.3.1 failure (and its staging unhealthy run as v2.3.1-rc, which unfortunately didn't catch this) should be investigated by the owning team before re-deploying.
